base: Single square photoreal early-2000s fisheye POV snapshot. MAXIMUM CHILL: completely at ease, zero tension, cozy, sleepy, unbothered. An adult animal with surreal human features attached naturally to its own body. Close wide-angle lens with strong barrel distortion and soft dark corners, warm ambient light plus direct point-and-shoot flash, slightly grainy 2003 digital-camera texture. Real fur or skin and entirely real mundane surroundings. Candid goofy photo, not cartoon or illustration. No lettering, slogans, posters, labels, watermark or collage; plain unbranded objects. Scene:

scenes.title: spin cycle
scenes.scene: An adult gray tabby slouches on a molded plastic laundromat chair, its own human hands folded loosely over its belly, watching the dryer with sleepy half-closed eyes.

scenes.title: usual order
scenes.scene: An adult raccoon sunk into a cracked red diner booth, its own human hand loosely holding a thick white coffee mug, elbow on the table, half-eaten toast nearby.

scenes.title: off the clock
scenes.scene: An adult basset hound sprawled on brownstone steps at dusk, wearing a loose white undershirt, its own human hand holding a cigarette away from its face, completely relaxed droopy eyes.

scenes.title: pool hours
scenes.scene: An adult capybara melting into a cheap poolside deckchair, tiny dark sunglasses, its own human feet crossed at the ankles in rubber slides, a plain beer bottle by the chair.

scenes.title: midnight snack
scenes.scene: An adult otter sitting on the kitchen floor against the refrigerator in warm midnight light, its own human hand holding a slice of cold pizza, blissfully sleepy.

scenes.title: balcony break
scenes.scene: An adult pigeon lounging in a battered folding chair on a small apartment balcony, its own long human legs stretched out in old sneakers, calm sideways glance, ordinary brick buildings behind.

scenes.title: porch weather
scenes.scene: An adult opossum lounging sideways in a sagging porch armchair, its own human hand holding a plain iced tea glass, tail hanging over the cushion, warm humid evening.

scenes.title: no bites
scenes.scene: An adult frog on a tiny folding stool at an ordinary pond, its own human hands resting loosely on a fishing rod, sleepy contented face, bucket beside its sneakers.

scenes.title: just a trim
scenes.scene: An adult tuxedo cat reclines far back in an old barber chair, a white towel around its neck, its own human hands resting on the armrests, eyes nearly closed with absolute contentment.

scenes.title: garage time
scenes.scene: An adult ferret in a loose faded tee sits low in a rolling garage chair, its own human hand holding a plain beer can, sneakers stretched toward the camera, ordinary cluttered tools and a parked car behind.

scenes.title: corner store
scenes.scene: An adult orange cat wearing a plain gold chain slouches on a milk crate outside a corner store at night, its own human hand holding two stacked plain white Styrofoam cups, heavy relaxed eyelids.

scenes.title: one more episode
scenes.scene: An adult quokka deeply sunk into a worn sofa, its own human hand loosely holding a TV remote on its belly, one socked human foot on the coffee table, only the glow of a television and on-camera flash.
